About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Mid-Market Sales Specialist

Role summary:

We’re looking for a highly motivated Mid-Market Sales Specialist within the GTM organization, supporting customers across the EMEA region.
The ideal candidate is energetic, eager to learn, and ready to grow in a fast-paced environment.
You will support our customers’ onboarding journey and growth, while helping identify revenue opportunities and deliver an excellent customer experience.

Israel
Hybrid
Full-time

What You’ll Do:

- Support onboarding for new SMB customers across domestic and global markets through telesales outreach, timely follow-ups, and low-touch engagement that helps drive activation and compliance completion.

1. Use CRM tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Aircall, and Marketo to support customer onboarding, assist with KYC completion, and engage prospects through structured call, email, and messaging outreach such as WhatsApp or Telegram.

2. Apply effective communication, active listening, and problem-solving skills to guide customers through the onboarding process and help improve conversion outcomes.

3. Manage communication with new accounts through calls, emails, and automated sequences while working closely with operations teams to support activation and approvals.

4. Help address onboarding, operational, and payment-related issues in a timely manner to support a smooth customer experience and encourage first funded transactions.

- Support onboarding and activation goals for the assigned portfolio by maintaining consistent outreach, encouraging progress to first funded transaction, and introducing customers to relevant Payoneer products where appropriate.

- Proactively share feedback, insights and ideas in team meetings to contribute towards new business growth

Who you are:

- Bachelor’s degree.

- 2-3 years of experience in B2B sales, telesales, inside sales, customer onboarding, customer service, or a related field; internships or early sales experience are an advantage.

- Strong sales acumen with the ability to work in an aggressive, target-driven environment, manage high activity volumes, prioritize effectively, and consistently deliver against deadlines and conversion goals.

- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

- Fluency in English and Hebrew is a must, with excellent spoken communication, strong call handling ability, and the confidence to engage customers persuasively over the phone.

- Candidates with prior BPO, call center, telesales, or inside sales experience will be strongly preferred, especially those who have managed aggressive follow-up cadences and volume-based onboarding or activation targets.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong persuasive ability, organized reporting, and effective coordination across sales and operations stakeholders.

- Strong desire to learn industry best practices, contribute to the organization, and continuously improve onboarding, activation, and FFT performance outcomes.

#LI-MI1

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build each other up
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

description:
The Radar NPI group supports the introduction of new automotive radar products from early R&D through prototype stages, industrialization and production ramp toward high-volume manufacturing.

This position is intended for students only. Applicants must be actively pursuing a B.Sc./M.Sc. degree and have at least two years remaining until graduation.

We are looking for a hands-on NPI Student to support engineering teams and take ownership of the operational execution behind NPI activities.

The role combines BOM and component management, procurement, supplier coordination, logistics, budget monitoring and execution of engineering requests through Jira.

The position requires close daily interaction with HW engineers, NPI engineers, subcontractors, suppliers, purchasing, finance, logistics and supply-chain teams.

The position requires at least 3.5 days per week working from the office.

This role provides hands-on experience in New Product Introduction (NPI), supply chain, manufacturing operations and product industrialization within a cutting-edge automotive radar development environment.

The position offers broad exposure to the complete product lifecycle, from early development and prototype builds through production ramp and high-volume manufacturing.

What will your job look like?
- Support Radar R&D and NPI projects from prototype builds through industrialization and production ramp.

- Manage BOM/component procurement according to project and build milestones, including availability checks and delivery follow-up.

- Maintain and monitor component inventory and material required for engineering and NPI builds.

- Coordinate material and kits required for PCB assembly, SMT, rework, DOE and other engineering activities with subcontractors.

- Create and manage purchase requests, including quarterly and on-demand requests.

- Follow PO approval flow, supplier confirmation, delivery dates and required BCM dates.

- Work directly with suppliers and subcontractors to obtain quotations and ensure materials/services arrive according to project requirements.

- Perform weekly and quarterly budget and PO follow-up, including invoice reconciliation and open commitments.

- Coordinate and track local and international shipments of components, PCBs, engineering samples, radar units, cables and equipment.

- Own shipment execution through final confirmation of receipt.

- Manage engineering and internal-customer demand for radar units, boards, cables and related equipment.

- Maintain purchasing, shipment and operational activities through Jira, ensuring requests are properly documented and followed through closure.

- Coordinate activities across R&D, NPI, Supply Chain, Purchasing, Finance, Logistics and external vendors.

- Support general NPI and lab operational activities as required.

- Serve as a key focal point, ensuring engineering teams have the materials, services and logistics support required to meet program milestones and build schedules.

All you need is:
- B.Sc. student in Industrial Engineering or Electrical Engineering with at least 2 years remaining until graduation.

- Availability for at least 3.5 working days per week.

- Strong technical orientation and ability to understand electronic components, BOMs, PCB assemblies and engineering requirements.

- Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple parallel activities, priorities and deadlines.

- Strong ownership and follow-up skills, with the ability to drive activities through completion.

- Good communication skills and ability to work with engineers, suppliers and cross-functional teams.

- Strong Excel skills.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Strong analytical skills and ability to manage operational data, procurement status, inventory tracking and project deliverables.

Nice to have:
- Experience in electronics manufacturing, NPI or production environments.

- Familiarity with PCB/SMT manufacturing and electronic components.

- Experience working with BOMs, purchasing, suppliers or subcontractors.

- Experience with Jira, ERP/PO systems or inventory management systems.

- Experience coordinating logistics or engineering-material shipments.

- Experience with advanced Excel functions such as Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, dashboard creation.

- Relevant military logistics, operations or supply-chain experience.

Why Join Us?
This position is an excellent opportunity for students seeking hands-on experience in NPI, supply chain, manufacturing operations, and product industrialization. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams and gain exposure to the end-to-end process of bringing innovative automotive radar products from development into mass production.

Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!

IRC’s goal is to continually improve the economic, social and cultural wellbeing of the Inuvialuit through implementation of the IFA and by all other available means.

Through strong partnerships and community‑driven programs, the organization supports economic growth, cultural preservation and opportunities for current and future generations.

Inuvialuit beneficiaries directly control IRC and its subsidiaries through a democratic process of elected directors from each of the six community corporations with chairs at the IRC Board, a process originally outlined in the IFA. description:
Are you interested in building systems that move beyond reacting to customer behavior, to actually understanding and remembering it over time? Our team is building Amazon’s customer memory layer – a system that extracts, curates, and reasons over customer knowledge to power next-generation personalization. This includes transforming noisy, unstructured signals into durable, high-quality representations of customer preferences, intents, and life events, and using them in real time to improve customer experiences.

We are part of Amazon’s Personalization organization, a high-performing group that leverages large-scale machine learning, generative AI, and distributed systems to deliver highly relevant customer experiences.

We tackle challenging problems at the intersection of information extraction, knowledge representation, LLM reasoning, and recommendation systems. Our systems operate under real-world constraints of scale, latency, and quality, requiring careful tradeoffs between precision, recall, and responsiveness. This team plays a central role in defining how Amazon understands its customers, and how that understanding is applied across the shopping experience.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer with sound technical judgment and a bias for action who takes ownership of problems end to end, communicates clearly, and cares about operational excellence - not just launching features, but making sure they hold up at scale. Someone who naturally raises the bar for the team: mentoring junior developers, advocating engineering best practices, and thinking beyond the immediate sprint.

Key job responsibilities

- Design, build, test, and operate production AI features used by multiple teams and operating at Amazon scale

- Deliver end-to-end solutions with focus on maintainability, scalability, performance, and reliability

- Collaborate with Product and Science to define experiences, run experiments, and iterate based on data

- Build AI-powered experiences including personalized recommendations, relevance explanations, and knowledge-driven features using LLMs and generative AI

- Define and implement measurement strategies including analytics events and experiment configurations to track engagement and retention

- Navigate ambiguity and make sound technical decisions in a problem space where established patterns don't always apply

About the team

Our team is part of Amazon's Personalization organization, a high-performing group that leverages Amazon's expertise in machine learning, big data, distributed systems, and user experience design to deliver the best shopping experiences for our customers.

Our vision is to enhance customer shopping experience on Amazon by leveraging personalization techniques. We strive to save customers valuable time by tailoring their journey to their individual needs, interests, and preferences. Our goal involves identifying personalization opportunities to develop and optimize customer experiences, thereby improving the overall search and discovery process across Amazon.

Basic qualifications
- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design

- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

Preferred qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

- Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large-scale systems

- Knowledge of machine learning model architecture and inference

- Experience in building complex systems using a fully agentic-AI flow (AI-Native)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information.
